metricNotes.coupling: Measures inbound coupling (fan-in) only. A zone with coupling: 0 (e.g. routes) means no other zone imports from it — it does NOT mean the zone has no outbound dependencies. Routes has the highest outbound import count (depends on hooks, components) but this is expected for a leaf layer. Do not interpret low inbound coupling as low overall coupling for leaf zones.
metricNotes.cohesion: Infrastructure zones (build-infrastructure, project-infrastructure, code-quality-config) report cohesion: 0 because their files are standalone config artifacts with no mutual imports. This is structurally normal — config files are not modules that import each other — and does not indicate logical fragmentation. A cohesion score of 0 in these zones should not be treated as a warning.
